tsp.text: Venser is an artificer who lives alone in a workshop in the Urborg swamps, salvaging Phyrexian remains and building his Ambulator while drawing Windgrace's ire. Teferi finds him while researching the rift above Urborg, and senses that both Venser and Radha have planeswalker sparks different from his own.

When Venser demonstrates the ambulator, the rift reacts violently and the whole group is pulled through, witnessing the events that caused Dominaria's rifts. A disembodied voice then tricks Venser and uses his and Radha's latent sparks to regain a body, revealing itself as Nicol Bolas.

Venser travels with Jhoira to the Ghitu and perfects his throne device with Thran metal and powerstones, but a flaw sends him, Teferi and Jhoira to an alternate timeline, and Venser completes his first planeswalk home. Windgrace then catches him, and Venser becomes one of his gladehunters.

Later Jeska studies the rifts and uses Radha as her tool, and is stopped by Venser and company at great cost to Radha's spark and Zhalfir. Jeska casts Venser and Radha back and sacrifices herself, and the Mending takes place, after which Venser gives Jhoira the ambulator and planeswalks off to an unknown destination.

plc.text: In Planar Chaos, Venser, Teferi and Jhoira restore the wayward region of Shiv to its natural place in Dominaria, healing one rift, though their attempt to teleport to Urborg leaves them facing the chaos of an alternate Dominaria. Teferi has sealed the rift but is drained of all powers, so Jhoira and Venser take him to the Ghitu, who help Venser build a new ambulator.

Venser is captured by Windgrace in Urborg, who later takes the group to the Blind Eternities to meet Freyalise. The Weaver King follows Jodah and Venser to Skyshroud and takes control of the slivers and Phyrexians, torturing Venser, and Freyalise closes a rift by channeling all her mana into it and consuming herself.
Venser tricks the Weaver King and kills him by rupturing powerstones, planeswalking while holding a pair of them.

som.text: In Scars of Mirrodin, Koth and Elspeth find Venser in his workshop, where he shows them his planeshifting ship built from Phyrexian parts. Koth recognizes the parts, threatens Venser and traps his head in a stone mask to force him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.

The group is ambushed by nim in the Mephidross, and Venser and Koth are captured by a Corrupted Harvester until Elspeth reappears and the trio escape. In the Oxidda Chain Venser disables a leveler, and he reveals to Koth that he is actually seeking Karn.

Venser and Koth are later captured in the Mephidross and brought to the Phyrexian lair at Ish Sah, where Koth melts his manacles and Elspeth kills the Phyrexians and frees Venser. The trio reaches the Mirran resistance led by Ezuri, who backs down when Elspeth threatens him.

Tezzeret captures Elspeth and Venser, and Koth and Melira free them so they reach Karn's throne room. Melira cleanses Karn's body but not his heart, so Venser donates his life and spark to Karn, who reignites and regains his memories and vows to stop the Phyrexians.

mbs.text: Mirrodin Besieged follows Venser's journey to its end. Elspeth breaks into Ish Sah and frees her companions, who fight Phyrexian butchers and escape through a meat shaft. They meet the rebel leader Ezuri, who backs down when threatened, and free Melira from Tezzeret.
Venser gives his life and spark to Karn, curing the golem and releasing him from Phyrexian tyranny.
